title: Tour lab stages
summary: How the circuit is set up: stage types, overdue days, alerts and deactivated stages.

steps.title: Menu → Business Setup → Lab Stages
steps.details: The stages every lab order goes through, in order.

steps.title: Active stages
steps.details: In circuit order (drag them by the left handle). Exactly one initial stage, where every new order starts, and at least one final. The days set when an order in that stage becomes overdue.

steps.title: Stage alerts
steps.details: The bell shows how many alerts it has: on entry, by time in stage and by past due date.

steps.title: Deactivated stages
steps.details: A stage that had orders is not deleted: it is deactivated and can be reactivated.

steps.title: Save
steps.details: Nothing applies until you save; the whole setup is saved together.
